name: comp-215
blurb: Select field with some options disabled.
description: A shadcn Select with the disabled prop on specific SelectItems to prevent selection of certain options while keeping them visible.
use_when: Some options are temporarily unavailable or require certain conditions before selection.
avoid_when: When all options should be selectable or when you prefer to hide unavailable options.
a11y: Disabled options are marked aria-disabled; screen readers announce the state.
